candidate_binding: execution-criteria.json source_sha256; containing corrective commit, no self-reference
crash_injection: BaseException at exact durable boundaries, leaving persisted state for recovery; no false claim of OS process-kill testing
creation_transaction: P11 call + PENDING admission owner + CREATED outbox intent
deadline_fixture: After outage, privileged isolated test fixture advances only admission timestamps with triggers disabled transaction-locally. Production runtime cannot mutate deadline/owner; separate negative SQL tests prove it. Races use asyncio barriers and PostgreSQL row locks, not sleeps.
dispatch_transaction: call/admission/permit locks; exact owner and live permit; PENDING->DISPATCHED; conservative dispatch-unconfirmed marker; commit before ARI
limitations: DISPATCHED commit is conservatively ambiguous even if physical ARI had not begun; never automatically retried.
Operations must invoke bounded tenant recovery after outages for untouched calls; no fleet-wide background failover is introduced.
Legacy calls without an admission fence are not retrospectively classified safe to fail.
recovery_operation: TelephonyService.recover_pending_admissions(organization_id, limit=1..100); call reads/lists and same-key replay also reconcile expired PENDING
recovery_transaction: call/admission/permit locks; expired PENDING->REVOKED; AUTHORIZED permit->REVOKED; FAILED call + one outbox event
strategy: B: durable pre-provider owner, immutable database deadline, irreversible state CAS
total_outage_proof: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL database: ALLOW_CONNECTIONS false plus terminate ALL sessions; new connections rejected; failure persistence remains unavailable; restore database and recover the durable fence
